definitionEn: to wait for something that you expect to happen or arrive
situation: You are waiting, often formally or patiently, for a decision, a result, a reply or an event.

examples.text: Fans are eagerly [[awaiting]] the band's first album in ten years.
Thousands of patients are [[awaiting]] routine operations after the winter crisis.
She [[awaited]] the results of the interview with growing anxiety.

texts: Several patients are still [[awaiting]] surgery.
The plan is [[awaiting]] approval from head office.
The film festival is [[awaiting]] final confirmation of its dates.

badCollocation.noteRu: После await не ставится for: await the results или wait for the results.

collocationTask.explanationRu: «Долгожданный» — long-awaited: the long-awaited sequel. Waited и hoped без for так не работают, а attended значит «посещённый».

nuance.text: The committee is still [[awaiting]] the final report from the auditors.
nuance.explanationRu: Await — переходный глагол, дополнение идёт сразу: await the report. Wait требует предлога: wait for the report. Без for waiting здесь ошибка.

reverse.text: I'll [[wait]] for you outside the station.
reverse.explanationRu: С предлогом for и в бытовой речи — wait: I'll wait for you. Await for — ошибка, да и звучит await слишком официально.

fixIt.text: The two suspects are in prison [[expecting]] trial.
fixIt.explanationRu: «В ожидании суда» — awaiting trial, это устойчивое сочетание. Expect — «предполагать, рассчитывать», с trial так не говорят.

reply.context: Your manager emails: "Any news from the client about the contract?"
options: Not yet — we're still awaiting their decision, probably by Friday.
Not yet — I awaited for them at reception for an hour.
reply.explanationRu: Awaiting their decision — ждём их решения, естественный деловой ответ. Await for — ошибка, а третий ответ слишком небрежный для письма руководителю.

rewrite.original: The patients are waiting for the results of their tests.
rewrite.frame: The patients are ____ the results of their tests.
rewrite.explanationRu: Await something — ждать чего-то, без предлога for.

definitionEn: the general situation or conditions in which a particular event happens
senseNote: Выбрано переносное значение «фон событий» (against a backdrop of), а не театральный задник.
situation: You describe the wider situation, such as a crisis or rising prices, in which an event takes place.

examples.text: The election is taking place against a [[backdrop]] of rising food prices.
The novel is set against the [[backdrop]] of the economic crisis of the 1990s.
Falling sales formed the [[backdrop]] to the merger talks.

texts: Rising rents provide the [[backdrop]] to the film's story.
The protests took place against a [[backdrop]] of high unemployment.
Her childhood in the war is the [[backdrop]] to the whole memoir.

badCollocation.noteRu: «На фоне» — against a backdrop of, а не on. Предлог on здесь — калька с русского.

collocationTask.explanationRu: «На фоне чего-то» — against a backdrop of. On, under и over с backdrop в этом значении не используются.

nuance.text: The summit took place against a [[backdrop]] of rising tension in the region.
nuance.explanationRu: «На фоне» — against a backdrop of. Context используется с другими предлогами: in the context of, out of context; against a context так не говорят.

reverse.text: His words were taken out of [[context]] by the newspapers.
reverse.explanationRu: Вырвать слова из контекста — take out of context. Backdrop так не употребляется: это фон событий, а не смысловое окружение фразы.

fixIt.text: The negotiations started against a [[landscape]] of growing distrust between the two companies.
fixIt.explanationRu: «На фоне растущего недоверия» — against a backdrop of. Landscape — «пейзаж» или «общая картина» (the political landscape), но не в этом обороте.

reply.context: A friend asks: "Why did that new café close so quickly?"
options: It opened with a backdrop of fifty kinds of cake, but nobody came.
The establishment commenced trading against a most unfavourable economic backdrop.
It opened against a backdrop of rising rents — it never really had a chance.
reply.explanationRu: Against a backdrop of rising rents — «на фоне роста аренды», это причина закрытия. Пятьдесят тортов — не backdrop, а второй ответ звучит как отчёт, а не разговор с другом.

rewrite.original: The election took place at a time when prices were rising fast.
rewrite.frame: The election took place ____ of rapidly rising prices.
rewrite.explanationRu: Against a backdrop of — «на фоне» чего-то.

definitionEn: help or support, especially financial or political, that makes something possible
senseNote: Выбрано значение «поддержка (финансовая, политическая)»; в музыке backing — ещё и «аккомпанемент» (backing vocals).
situation: Investors, politicians or partners support a plan with money, votes or approval so that it can go ahead.

examples.text: The project now has the full [[backing]] of the local council, so work can start in May.
The start-up secured financial [[backing]] from two large investment funds.
Without her family's [[backing]], she could never have opened her own restaurant.

texts: The plan won strong [[backing]] from local businesses.
The film was made with [[backing]] from a streaming service.
The union gave its full [[backing]] to the strike.

badCollocation.noteRu: Техническая поддержка — technical support. Backing — поддержка деньгами, голосами или авторитетом, а не помощь пользователям.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Заручиться поддержкой — win the backing of. Backup — резерв или копия, backbone — «хребет, опора», backlash — волна недовольства.

nuance.text: The mayor's new housing plan has the [[backing]] of most residents.
nuance.explanationRu: Backing — поддержка и одобрение людей, денег или организаций. Backup — запасной вариант, резервная копия или подкрепление; «резерв жителей» здесь бессмысленно.

reverse.text: Always keep a [[backup]] of your photos on an external drive.
reverse.explanationRu: Резервная копия файлов — backup. Backing — поддержка (финансовая или политическая), к копиям фото она не относится.

fixIt.text: The research was carried out with the financial [[maintenance]] of three universities.
fixIt.explanationRu: Финансовая поддержка — financial backing (или support). Maintenance — «техническое обслуживание, содержание», например maintenance of buildings.

wordFormation.text: The proposal has strong [[backing]] from the business community.

definitionEn: extra people, equipment or plans that can be used if something goes wrong
senseNote: Выбрано значение «подкрепление, резерв, запасной вариант»; «резервная копия файлов» — более простое и узкое значение.
situation: You arrange extra help, a spare plan or a spare machine in case something goes wrong.

examples.text: When the crowd grew angry, the two officers radioed for [[backup]].
Always have a [[backup]] in case the main speaker cancels at the last minute.
We keep a small generator as a [[backup]] in case the power fails.

texts: The event organisers need a [[backup]] plan for bad weather.
The pilot can switch to a [[backup]] system if the engine fails.
Nurses called for [[backup]] when the ward got too busy.

badCollocation.noteRu: Поддержка правительства — the backing (или support) of the government. Backup — резерв или подкрепление на случай проблем.

collocationTask.prompt: a ___ plan in case something goes wrong
collocationTask.explanationRu: Запасной план — a backup plan (или plan B). Spare plan и stock plan — кальки, а reserved plan значит «забронированный план».

nuance.text: If the bridge is closed, our [[backup]] route is the ring road.
nuance.explanationRu: Запасной вариант на случай проблем — backup: backup route, backup plan. Reserve — запас ресурсов (oil reserves, in reserve); «резервный маршрут» так не называют.

reverse.text: Try to keep some money in [[reserve]] for emergencies.
reverse.explanationRu: Держать деньги про запас — keep in reserve. In backup так не говорят: backup — подкрепление, запасной план или резервная копия.

fixIt.text: Always have a [[spare]] plan in case the venue cancels your booking.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Запасной план» — backup plan (или plan B). Spare подходит к вещам: spare key, spare tyre, а не к планам.

definitionEn: money paid to a court so that an accused person can stay free until their trial
situation: A judge lets an arrested person go home before the trial if money is paid to guarantee they will return.

examples.text: He was released on [[bail]] and must return to court next month.
The judge refused [[bail]] because she believed he might leave the country.
In the film, the hero sells his car to get his brother out of jail on [[bail]].

texts: The suspect's lawyer applied for [[bail]] on Monday.
She was freed on [[bail]] after two nights in a cell.
Lawyers will ask the judge to grant [[bail]] tomorrow.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Под залог» — on bail, а не under bail: be released on bail.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Разрешить освобождение под залог — grant bail. Let требует конструкции let someone go, admit — «признавать», pass — «передавать».

nuance.text: The court set [[bail]] at $50,000 and ordered him to hand in his passport.
nuance.explanationRu: Русское «залог» бывает разным. Деньги суду, чтобы обвиняемого отпустили до процесса, — bail. Deposit — залог за квартиру или аванс при покупке.

reverse.text: The landlord kept our [[deposit]] because of the broken window.
reverse.explanationRu: Залог за съёмную квартиру — deposit. Bail — только залог в суде за обвиняемого.

fixIt.text: The businessman was released on [[collateral]] until his trial in March.
fixIt.explanationRu: Освобождение до суда под денежный залог — on bail. Collateral — залог по кредиту, то есть имущество, которое может забрать банк.

reply.context: While watching a crime series, your friend asks: "Wait, why is he at home? Wasn't he arrested?"
options: He paid a bail to his landlord, so he got his flat back.
He's out on bail until the trial — that's why the police are watching him.
The individual was released on bail pending trial, as per standard procedure.
reply.explanationRu: Out on bail — отпущен под залог до суда. Залог за квартиру — deposit, а не bail. Третий ответ звучит как полицейский протокол, а не реплика другу.

rewrite.original: The judge let him go home until the trial because his family paid money to the court.
rewrite.frame: The judge released him ____ until the trial.
rewrite.explanationRu: Release someone on bail — отпустить под залог.

definitionEn: a paper or electronic form on which you mark your choice in an election
senseNote: Выбрано значение «избирательный бюллетень»; ballot также значит «тайное голосование» (hold a ballot).
situation: On election day, voters mark their choice on a paper and put it into a sealed box.

examples.text: Election staff spent the whole night counting the [[ballots]] by hand.
Don't forget to sign the envelope before you post your [[ballot]].
Her name will appear on the [[ballot]] for the first time in next year's election.

texts: Voters must mark their [[ballot]] with a cross.
You can apply for a postal [[ballot]] online.
His [[ballot]] was rejected because he had signed it.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Бросить бюллетень» — не throw, а cast a ballot или put a ballot in the ballot box.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Проголосовать, опустить бюллетень — cast a ballot (или cast a vote). Make, give и do с ballot не сочетаются.

nuance.text: She put her [[ballot]] in the box and left the polling station.
nuance.explanationRu: Ballot — бюллетень, который заполняет избиратель. Poll — опрос общественного мнения (или сами выборы: go to the polls), но не листок в урне.

reverse.text: A new opinion [[poll]] shows the two parties level.
reverse.explanationRu: Опрос общественного мнения — opinion poll. Ballot — бюллетень для голосования, опросы им не называют.

fixIt.text: Voters must fold the [[bulletin]] before putting it into the box.
fixIt.explanationRu: Избирательный бюллетень — ballot (или ballot paper). Bulletin — ложный друг: это сводка новостей или информационный листок.

reply.context: A friend says: "I'll be abroad on election day. Can I still vote?"
options: Yes — apply for a postal ballot and send it back before the deadline.
Yes — just ballot your favourite candidate on social media.
Affirmative. A postal ballot may be requested via the relevant authority.
reply.explanationRu: Postal ballot — бюллетень для голосования по почте, это точный совет. Ballot не глагол «поддержать в соцсетях», а третий ответ звучит как официальная инструкция.

definitionEn: a long piece of cloth with a message on it, carried in a march or hung up
senseNote: Выбрано значение «транспарант, растяжка из ткани»; в интернете banner — ещё и рекламный баннер.
situation: At a protest, a festival or a stadium, people carry or hang a long cloth with words painted on it.

examples.text: Thousands of protesters marched through the city centre, carrying [[banners]] that demanded cleaner air.
Fans hung a huge [[banner]] from the stadium roof to welcome the team home.
A [[banner]] across the main street announced the summer food festival.

texts: Students painted a [[banner]] for the graduation ceremony.
A giant [[banner]] hung over the entrance of the new library.
Two climbers unfurled a [[banner]] on top of the bridge.

badCollocation.text: a roadside advertising [[banner]] the size of a bus
badCollocation.noteRu: Большой рекламный щит у дороги — billboard. Banner — полотнище из ткани с надписью или рекламный баннер на сайте.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Транспаранты несут или ими машут: carry или wave banners. Wear — носить одежду, drive — водить, dress — одевать.

nuance.text: Two students held a ten-metre [[banner]] above the crowd.
nuance.explanationRu: Banner — длинное полотнище с надписью, его несут или натягивают над улицей. Poster — бумажный плакат на стене; десятиметровые постеры над толпой не держат.

reverse.text: Her bedroom walls were covered with film [[posters]].
reverse.explanationRu: Бумажные плакаты на стенах — posters. Banner — полотнище для улицы, демонстрации или стадиона.

fixIt.text: The protesters waved [[transparencies]] with the words 'Save our hospital'.
fixIt.explanationRu: Русское «транспарант» — banner. Transparency — ложный друг: это «прозрачность» или плёнка для проектора.

definitionEn: only the most basic or smallest amount of something, with nothing extra
senseNote: Выбрано значение «минимальный, самый необходимый» (the bare minimum), а не базовое «голый, непокрытый».
situation: You talk about the smallest amount of something that is needed, such as effort, money or luggage.

examples.text: He does the [[bare]] minimum at work and leaves at five on the dot.
We packed only the [[bare]] essentials for the weekend: a tent, water and some food.
The report gives only the [[bare]] facts, without any explanation or analysis.

texts: She earns the [[bare]] minimum needed to pay the rent.
Their tiny flat had nothing beyond the [[bare]] necessities.
Tell me the [[bare]] facts first; the details can wait.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Голый оклад» без премий — basic salary. Bare в этом значении живёт в устойчивых фразах: the bare minimum, the bare essentials.

collocationTask.explanationRu: «Делать самый минимум» — do the bare minimum. Least, lowest и smallest с bare не сочетаются.

nuance.text: I only had time to learn the [[bare]] minimum before the exam.
nuance.explanationRu: Bare — «минимальный»: the bare minimum, the bare essentials. Naked — «голый, без одежды» и устойчивые фразы вроде the naked eye; «голый минимум» с naked не говорят.

reverse.text: These tiny insects are invisible to the [[naked]] eye.
reverse.explanationRu: «Невооружённым глазом» — to the naked eye, это устойчивое выражение. The bare eye — ошибка.

fixIt.text: Tired students often do the [[naked]] minimum of reading before a seminar.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Самый минимум» — the bare minimum. Naked значит «голый, без одежды» и в этом выражении не используется.

wordFormation.text: I could [[barely]] hear the speaker from the back of the hall.

reply.context: A colleague asks: "How much time should I spend on the monthly report?"
options: Honestly, keep it bare — print it without a cover and leave it on the desk.
Merely the bare minimum is requisite, I would posit.
Honestly, just the bare minimum — nobody reads past the first page.
reply.explanationRu: The bare minimum — «самый минимум», естественный совет коллеге. В первом ответе bare понято как «без обложки», а второй звучит неестественно книжно.

rewrite.original: We only took the things we absolutely needed.
rewrite.explanationRu: The bare essentials / necessities — только самое необходимое.

definitionEn: a unit for measuring oil, equal to about 159 litres
senseNote: Выбрано значение «баррель (мера нефти)», а не базовое «бочка».
situation: News reports and traders talk about the price or the daily production of crude oil.

examples.text: Oil prices climbed above $90 a [[barrel]] after the announcement.
The country produces about two million [[barrels]] of oil a day.
In our economics class we learned why oil is priced per [[barrel]], not per litre.

texts: Crude oil fell to $70 a [[barrel]] on Friday.
Analysts expect the price per [[barrel]] to rise this winter.
Each [[barrel]] equals roughly 159 litres of oil.

badCollocation.noteRu: «90 долларов за баррель» — $90 a barrel или $90 per barrel, но не for barrel.

collocationTask.prompt: two million ___ of oil a day
collocationTask.explanationRu: Добычу нефти измеряют в баррелях: million barrels a day. Tanks, bottles и buckets для этого не используются.

nuance.text: Crude oil is traded on world markets at around $80 a [[barrel]].
nuance.explanationRu: Сырую нефть на мировых рынках считают в баррелях: $80 a barrel. Gallon — мера бензина на заправках в США, а не цены нефти на бирже.

reverse.text: In the US, petrol is sold by the [[gallon]], not by the litre.
reverse.explanationRu: На американских заправках бензин продают галлонами — by the gallon. В баррелях считают сырую нефть в торговле, а не бензин на заправке.

fixIt.text: The price of crude oil jumped to almost $100 a [[cask]] after the storm.
fixIt.explanationRu: Нефть измеряют в баррелях: $100 a barrel. Cask — бочка для вина или пива, в торговле нефтью это слово не используется.
